opportunityId.title: Opportunity Id
opportunityId.description: The 15 or 18 character Salesforce Id of the Opportunity. Starts with 006.

confirm.title: Confirm
confirm.description: False or omitted previews without saving. True performs the close. Only set true after the user has reviewed the preview.

primaryReason.title: CL Primary Reason
primaryReason.description: Required picklist: Bad Fit Disqualified, Budget Financial, Business Change, Competitive Loss, Duplicate, No Need, No Show / Buyer Canceled, Product / Technical Gap, Security Compliance, Timing Priority, Wrong Authority.

secondaryReason.title: CL Secondary Reason
secondaryReason.description: Optional picklist: Hebbia, Claude, Perplexity, BlueFlame, Internal Build, Inaccuracy / Hallucination, Latency / Performance, Missing 3P Data, Missing 1P Data, Budget Not Approved, Funding Shifted, Perceived price too high.

finalCompetitor.title: Final Competitor
finalCompetitor.description: Optional picklist: AlphaSense, BlueFlame, ChatGPT, Claude, Hebbia, Internal Build, ModelML, Perplexity.

notes.title: CL Notes
notes.description: Why the deal was lost. Defaults to the AI narrative when blank.

lobDivision.title: LOB/Division
lobDivision.description: Required picklist: Investment Banking, Commercial Banking, Corporate Banking, Corporate Finance, Wealth Management, Asset Management, Private Equity, Private Credit, Hedge Fund, Venture Capital / Ventures, Corporate Development, Sales & Trading / Markets.
